schemaMapping.sourceEnvelope: game-log.json: seasonId=20262027, gameTypeId=2, gameLog array; player identity binds endpoint path because no top-level playerId. Ignore playerStatsSeasons entirely.
schemaMapping.rowSelection: Exactly one gameLog row with gameId2026020177 and matching teamAbbrev TBL, opponentAbbrev UTA and provider gameDate; require matching schedule games[].id, season, gameType, sides and date. No latest-row guess.
schemaMapping.PPP: gameLog[].powerPlayPoints; finite nonnegative safe integer, distinct from powerPlayGoals; require PPP<=G+A
schemaMapping.SOG: gameLog[].shots; finite nonnegative safe integer, never infer from percentage
schemaMapping.PIM: gameLog[].pim; legacy baseline maps to penalty minutes; source credit/unit definition still needs owner evidence before semantic acceptance
schemaMapping.HIT: Field absent from every inspected gameLog row; unavailable, never zero
schemaMapping.BLK: Field absent from every inspected gameLog row; unavailable, never zero
schemaMapping.TOI: gameLog[].toi in m:ss; source parser convention, not official game-credit proof
schemaMapping.schedule: games[].startTimeUTC is scheduled time as observed; gameState OFF finality is not authoritative actual start/end. Home/away canonical team IDs are available.
schemaMapping.appearance: Row inclusion/TOI does not independently validate the v2 credited-appearance taxonomy, zero-minute penalty-only, dressed-unused or verified nonappearance. Keep v2 appearance label unqualified/ambiguous unless separate proof supplied.
schemaMapping.affiliation: Game row team identity available; dated bitemporal affiliation and independent eligible-opportunity census not established. Do not infer complete roster opportunity population.
